fetches.note: weeks 1-4; 0 stored, 4 fetched; no stats feed for week 2 (rostered players only)

history.note: Projected vs actual points in your league's scoring. Projections recorded before kickoff by earlier runs are used when available; otherwise the feed's projections for past weeks are fetched afterwards.

matchup.note: Projection-only optimisation: correlation, game script and opponent defensive matchups are not modelled.

win_probability.note: Each starter scores around their projection with a spread by position (normal, floored at 0, wider for bigger projections); players whose game has started count at their current points. Players are treated as independent: same-game correlation is not modelled.
win_probability.spread_source: this season's projection misses for QB, RB, TE, WR; typical spreads for the rest

projections.note: Projection feed is not part of Sleeper's documented read-only API and is treated as an unstable dependency.

opportunity.note: Earlier weeks vs the last two (of the last four with usage). Breakout: snap share up 15+ points to 45%+, or targets + carries up by 4+ and half again. Losing role: snap share down 15+ points from 40%+, or targets + carries down 4+ and by 40%.

projection_sources.note: PPR points from each source (league scoring can't be applied to ESPN's totals). Disagreement: 4+ points and 30%+ apart. Your roster, plus free agents projected 8+ by either source.

trades.method: Optimal-starter points by position, bench value above replacement, and re-optimised lineups for both teams after each swap.
